# Fallout 76 Patch Notes – January 20, 2026

January 20, 2026

Our latest update for Fallout 76 brings some improvements to Appalachia.Our latest update is here, bringing a number of improvements and bug fixes to your adventures in Appalachia (and Burning Springs!).

## Update version 1.7.23.11 and download sizes

Here you can find out the download size of today's update on the respective platform:

**PC (Steam)**: 14.7 GB
**PC (Microsoft Store)**: 26.7 GB
**Xbox**: 28.9GB
**PlayStation**: 12.8GB

## Armor (and outfits)

- The Adrenal and Clear Mind mods should now display with their dynamic names for armor with the legendary effect.
- Fixed a bug that caused the Cutthroat Helmet to appear with a different color scheme than in the Pip-Boy preview after equipping it on a character.
- Additional headgear and goggles can now be worn with the Ulysses mask.
- The Deathclaw Tamer Hat no longer removes a character's facial hair.
- Fixed an issue that caused the gloves on the male variant of the Light Rust Raider outfit to poke through some weapons in first person.
- Fixed an issue that caused the gloves on the female variant of the medium Rust Raider outfit to poke through some weapons in first person.
## C.A.M.P.

- The description for the wall-mounted oven now includes the note “Produces meat over time”.
- The Pumpkin Pie description now includes the note “Collect Pumpkin Pie Pieces over time.”
- Fixed a bug that could cause visual effects from the hunting lodge fireplace to disappear.
- The industrial fusion core charger no longer produces noise when not turned on.
- Fixed a bug that caused windows to not display correctly from the inside in the prebuilt Winter Refuge.
- Fixed missing collision in Dino Bite Gift Shop.
- The icon and actual appearance of the Red Clapboard wallpaper now match.
- The Medicine Cabinet Storage Crate icon has been increased in size.
- The brightness of the symbols for the Farmer's Market letter set has been reduced.
- Fixed inconsistencies in sound effects for footsteps in the Wrangler Casino property.
- Fixed a bug that caused Adventure on the Ohio Dock to incorrectly say it needed to be built on a foundation.
- Crafting the Abraxodyne Vice now consumes the correct amount of materials.
- The grille room lights now point in the expected direction.
- The health values ​​of the Bounty Board C.A.M.P. item have been adjusted to match the values ​​of similar C.A.M.P. items.
- Fixed a bug that prevented C.A.M.P. allies from correctly pathfinding around the RAD Scorpion Agitator.
- The baby doll head swimmer now swims like a swimmer should.
- Fixed a bug that caused the text for the posters to say “Fresh as morning dew!” and “Beautiful as a Sunset” was displayed backwards.
- The back of the “Beautiful as a Sunset” poster is no longer a mirror
